fossil_crinoid.name: Crinoid Stem
fossil_crinoid.description: Stacked stem segments from a sea lily-like animal.
fossil_crinoid.facts: Crinoids are echinoderms related to sea stars.
fossil_crinoid.showcase_notes: Columnar structure is great for scale displays.

fossil_shark_tooth.name: Shark Tooth
fossil_shark_tooth.description: Compact tooth fossil with serrated edges and dense enamel.
fossil_shark_tooth.facts: Shark teeth are among the most common fossil finds worldwide.

fossil_coprolite.name: Coprolite
fossil_coprolite.facts: Coprolites reveal diet details of extinct animals.

fossil_bone_fragment.name: Small Bone Fragment
fossil_bone_fragment.description: Small fossil bone shard with rough cortical texture.
fossil_bone_fragment.restoration_notes: Consolidant improves durability without altering shape.
fossil_bone_fragment.facts: Fragments can identify larger animals through microstructure.

set_trike_frill.name: Triceratops Frill Fragment
set_trike_frill.description: Frill fragment with distinctive bony ridges.
set_trike_frill.facts: Frills may have served for species recognition.

set_mosasaur_paddle.name: Mosasaur Paddle Bone
set_mosasaur_paddle.description: Paddle bone fragment from a mosasaur set.

fossil_brachiopod.name: Brachiopod
fossil_brachiopod.description: Marine shell fossil with bilateral symmetry.
fossil_brachiopod.facts: Brachiopods resemble clams but have different internal anatomy.

fossil_trilobite.name: Trilobite
fossil_trilobite.description: Segmented marine arthropod known for its armored exoskeleton.
fossil_trilobite.facts: Trilobites dominated Paleozoic seas for over 250 million years.

fossil_fern.name: Fern Impression
fossil_fern.description: Plant impression fossil preserving delicate leaf patterns.
fossil_fern.facts: Fern fossils often appear as carbon films in shale.

fossil_wood.name: Fossilized Wood
fossil_wood.description: Mineralized wood with preserved growth rings and texture.
fossil_wood.facts: Petrified wood forms when minerals replace organic tissue.

set_trike_tooth.name: Triceratops Tooth
set_trike_tooth.description: Tooth fragment from a Triceratops set piece.
set_trike_tooth.facts: Triceratops teeth were built for grinding plants.

set_mammoth_molar.name: Mammoth Molar
set_mammoth_molar.description: Large molar fragment with ridged enamel.
set_mammoth_molar.showcase_notes: Ridged surface looks striking in close-up.

fossil_ammonite.name: Ammonite
fossil_ammonite.description: Spiral-shelled cephalopod fossil common in marine rock beds.
fossil_ammonite.showcase_notes: Spiral silhouette reads clearly under strong museum light.
